neighbours.label: a word piece continuing a word that the tokenizer splits after a 'di-'/'dis-' start (di|ab|atic, diss|ipation, D|IA|LECT, dis|ulf|ide); whole-token di- words (direct, distance) and split words with other prefixes do not fire
fire: Water helps the salt undergo dissociation into its two ions.
Sexually dimorphic birds show bright plumage only in the males.
The diaphragm contracts and flattens as the lungs fill with air.
A diatomic gas such as nitrogen stores energy in rotation as well as motion.
A dichroic filter reflects one colour and passes the rest.
A dissonant chord resolves to a consonant one at the end of the phrase.
The dichotomy between theory and practice is sharper in medicine than in law.
A disulfide bridge holds the two chains of the protein together.
quiet: The pressure of the gas was different at the two ends of the pipe.
A monatomic gas such as helium stores energy only in motion.
The muscle contracts and flattens as the lungs fill with air.
A tetrahedral molecule such as methane has four bonds at equal angles.
A polarising filter reflects one colour and passes the rest.
A consonant chord ends the phrase with a feeling of rest.
The distance between theory and practice is greater in medicine than in law.
A hydrogen bond holds the two chains of the protein together.

predictions: Fire items 0.3-0.9 on the first or second piece after the di-/dis- start; single-token di- words and mon|atomic / tet|rah|edral style splits under 0.15.
notes: Probe: non-d|iss|ip|ative 0.876 on '-dis'(-d|iss), diabatic 0.808 on 'ab', DIALECT 0.828 on 'IA', dissipation 0.771 on ' diss', ad|i|ab|atic 0.609 on 'i', di|urnal 0.319, dip|ole 0.185 (weak: 'dip' is a word); single-token 'direct distance ... different' 0.010; floor 0.007. Negative pole is the same unit on relativ/definit/infinit pieces.
